category_edits.rationale: Apply a 0.2 pairwise ranking margin across all four datasets to encourage stronger positive-negative separation, retaining the 0.2 pointwise coefficient and valid-position averaging. Model architecture and inference remain unchanged.

change_summary: Add only a 0.2 margin to the shared pairwise loss. Preserve one GRU4Rec model per category and all other training and prediction settings.
